definition: to fly, glide in the air; to move like a bird in the sky.
example_en: The birds were flying about in the sky.

definition: stone work - a) the art or process of working in stone, as in masonry; b) something made or built in stone.
example: ಈ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಕಲುವೆಸ ನೋಡಲು ಬಹಳ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The stone work of this temple is very beautiful to look at.

definition: the act or fact of limping.
example_en: The old grandfather's limping was noticeable.

definition: a man who has expert knowledge in artistic quality, ability or work and keen discrimination in art, a connoisseur.
example: ಆ ಕಳಾಕೋವಿದ ಚಿತ್ರದ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That connoisseur noticed the fine details of the painting.

definition: the quality or state of not belonging to three dimensions; formlessness.
example_en: The formlessness of that artwork confused the viewers.

definition: prevented from; avoided; removed; warded off.
example_en: The child, warded off from danger, was safe.

definition: the fact or quality of being spatial.
example: ಈ ಕಾನೂನಿನ ದೇಶವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಇಡೀ ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The spatial extent of this law applies to the whole nation.

definition: (sound) to be made.
example_en: The sound of the bell was being made in the temple.

definition: to be amazed; to wonder at.
example_en: Seeing that magic trick, everyone was amazed.

definition: a man carrying a burden.
example: ಆ ಹೊರೆಕಾಱ ದಿನವಿಡೀ ಭಾರ ಹೊತ್ತು ದಣಿದಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That burden-carrier was tired from carrying loads all day.

definition: an abnormal thickening, and loss of elasticity, of the walls of the arteries, often present in old age; arteriosclerosis.
example_en: Arteriosclerosis is commonly found in old age.

definition: the right or proper custom or tradition.
example_en: They followed the proper custom without any deviation.

definition: a he-goat.
example_en: They sacrificed the he-goat for the worship.

definition: the space or region at the central portion.
example_en: There is a big market in the central region of the city.

definition: a reprimanding, compelling, intimidating using harsh or loud voice.
example_en: The officer intimidated the workers with harsh words.

definition: any ritual that is to be performed for one's father, ancestor or ancestors.
example_en: The son performed the ancestral ritual for his father with devotion.

definition: insulting or coarse language; abusive words or speech.
example: ಅವನು ಕೋಪದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀಚವಾಕ್ಯ ಆಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ನೋಯಿಸಿದ.
example_en: In anger, he spoke insulting words and hurt everyone.

definition: a raised platform adjoining the front wall of a building (as a house, temple, public hall, etc.) used as a sit-out.
example: ಹಿರಿಯರು ಸಂಜೆ ಜಗಲಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಮಾತನಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The elders sat on the raised platform in the evening and talked.

definition: weariness, exhaustion from bodily or mental exertion; fatigue.
example: ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ನಂತರ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅಲಸಟೆ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: He felt fatigue after the long journey.

definition: the state or an instance of being equal; equality.
example_en: There was equality between the two competitors.

definition: a kind of sweet dish.
example_en: They made the sweet dish at home for the festival.

definition: a stack of straw, hay etc.
example_en: Before the rainy season, the farmers built a stack of hay.

definition: to become abundant, superfluous.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಫಸಲು ಭುಲ್ಲಯಿಸಿ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಸಂತೋಷವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: This year the harvest became abundant, delighting the farmers.

definition: the rapture of absorption into the one self-existent Spirit.
example_en: Yogis experience the rapture of absorption into the Spirit through meditation.

definition: to smell (a substance) by sniffing; to sniff.
example_en: He sniffed the flower and enjoyed its fragrance.

definition: to cause to happen.
example_en: His words caused a quarrel to happen.

definition: to put forward in opposition; to make a statement objecting something; to object.
example_en: He objected to that proposal in the meeting.

definition: the condition of a business, commercial venture, becoming insolvent; bankruptcy.
example_en: The bankruptcy of the business shocked everyone.

definition: not compact or compactly tied, formed, constructed; loose.
example_en: The knot of the rope came loose, being not tightly tied.

definition: a group of people related by ancestry or marriage; relatives.
example_en: All the relatives gathered for the wedding.

definition: that which does not last long; a transient thing.
example_en: That relationship ended, being merely a transient thing.

definition: the art and sciece of sculpture.
example_en: He learned the art of sculpture from his teacher.

definition: a helping or being helped; help.
example_en: My friend's help was very useful to me.

definition: the plant Anisochilus carnosus of Lamiaceae family; thick leaved lavender.
example_en: The kapparaḷḷi plant has been planted in the courtyard for medicine.

definition: a sprout - a) a young growth on a plant, as a stem or branch; shoot; b) a new growth from a bud, rootstock, germinating seed, etc.
example: ಮಳೆಯ ನಂತರ ಗಿಡದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಇಗುರು ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: After the rain, a new sprout appeared on the branch of the plant.

definition: the relationship which arranges the elements in order of atomic weight and in groups of eight, with recurring similarity of properties.
example: ರಸಾಯನ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಷ್ಟಕನಿಯಮ ಮೂಲಧಾತುಗಳ ಜೋಡಣೆಯನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: In chemistry, the octet rule explains the arrangement of elements.

definition: the squirrel Petaurista philippensis; a flying squirrel.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿ ವೇಳೆ ಹಾರುಅಳಿಲು ಮರದಿಂದ ಮರಕ್ಕೆ ಜಿಗಿಯಿತು.
example_en: At night the flying squirrel leapt from tree to tree.

definition: a man who jests; a professional fool to amuse audience; a jester.
example_en: The jester entertained everyone in the royal court.

definition: the act of earning wages, salary, profit etc.
example_en: His earnings were good this year.

definition: a path; a course; a way.
example_en: He chose the right path to reach the goal.

definition: a cogulated mass (as of curds); a thick mass of coagulated liquid, esp. of blood; a clot.
example: ಗಾಯದಿಂದ ರಕ್ತ ಸೋರಿ ಒಂದು ಕರಣೆ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Blood oozed from the wound and formed a clot.

definition: having no moisture; not wet or damp.
example_en: The clothes became dry in the sun.

definition: (the tip of a creeper) to advance; to progress; to grow further.
example_en: During the rainy season the creeper's shoot advanced quickly.

definition: to perform religious rites for the dead person to help it attain a good state in heavens.
example_en: The priests performed the rites to help the dead man's soul attain a good state.

definition: a man, not having required qualification or not being chartered, carrying on the profession of or acting as a lawyer or legal adviser.
example_en: The people did not trust that unqualified lawyer.

definition: (a sound) to be suppressed completely.
example_en: Within a short while, the noise in the hall was completely suppressed.

definition: an elevated place; a mount; acclivity.
example: ಊರಿನ ಬಳಿಯ ಕೊಮದಿಂದ ಇಡೀ ಕಣಿವೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The whole valley can be seen from the mount near the village.

definition: to shout aloud.
example_en: He ran away shouting aloud in fear.

definition: approached; gone or come near; arrived at.
example_en: The disciple stood having approached near the teacher.

definition: the reverberating or ringing sonorously sound of a bell.
example_en: The temple bell made a ringing, reverberating sound.

definition: an upper, outer garment, either or not sleeved, worn by women; a blouse.
example_en: She got a new blouse stitched for herself.

definition: to cause to separate by cutting or severing.
example_en: He cut and severed the thread.

definition: a stretch of land where salt is made from sea water.
example_en: They make salt from sea water in the saltpan.

definition: the office of the cavalry division of an army.
example_en: The soldier worked in the cavalry division office.

definition: a hit, stroke, shot etc. which hits the target perfectly.
example_en: The hunter's perfect shot hit the animal exactly.

definition: a species of small succulent plant.
example: ಮಡಕೆಯ ಅಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರುದಂತಿ ಎಂಬ ಸಣ್ಣ ರಸಭರಿತ ಸಸ್ಯ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: A small succulent plant called rudanti has grown on the rim of the pot.

definition: a person whose religion is Judaism; any member of a group of Semitic peoples tracing descent from Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; an Israelite.
example: ಆ ನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಜ್ಯೂ ಸಮುದಾಯದ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸಿನಗಾಗ್ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a large synagogue of the Jewish community in that city.

definition: that which is done, acomplished; a work done.
example_en: This is a work accomplished through his effort.

definition: an onomatopoeic word used to express the feeling of emptiness.
example: ಖಾಲಿ ಮಡಕೆಯನ್ನು ಬಡಿದಾಗ ಬಿಮ್ಮು ಎಂಬ ಶಬ್ದ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: When the empty pot was struck, a hollow bimmu sound came.

definition: the state of not being of full or mature age.
example: ಅಪ್ರಾಪ್ತವಯಸ್ಕತೆಯ ಕಾರಣ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಚುನಾವಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ ಹಾಕಲು ಅವಕಾಶವಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because of his not being of full age, he has no opportunity to vote in the election.

definition: a big house; a mansion.
example: ಆ ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ದೊಡ್ಡಮನೆ ಊರಿನ ನಡುವೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That wealthy family's mansion stood in the middle of the town.

definition: a band or fold at the end of a sleeve, either sewed in or detachable; a cuff.
example_en: The cuff of his shirt sleeve was white in colour.

definition: a unsewn, oblong cloth worn by men around the waiste to cover the lower parts and one end of which is taken between the legs and tucked behind at the waist band; a dhōti.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ವೃದ್ಧರು ಇನ್ನೂ ಗಾಸೆಯುಟ್ಟು ಓಡಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The elders of that village still go about wearing the dhoti.

definition: a ripe mango fruit.
example_en: The ripe mango fell from the tree and ripened.

definition: to perceive visually; to look at; to see.
example_en: One can see the whole village from the top of the hill.

definition: a device for taking photographic images; a camera.
example_en: He bought a new camera.

definition: the act, art or practice of cheating.
example_en: Everyone knew of his practice of cheating.

definition: a tie or bond.
example: ಆ ಎರಡು ಹಗ್ಗಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಆಬಂಧನ ಬಿಗಿಯಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The tie between those two ropes was tight.

definition: a formal request in writing addressed to a judicial authority requesting for redressing, compensation etc.; a petition.
example_en: The villagers submitted a petition to the district collector.

definition: a rich fabric as of silk, rayon or nylon with a soft, thick pile; velvet.
example_en: They got the curtains stitched from velvet.

definition: the annual plant Amaranthus tenuifolius of Amaranthaceae family.
example_en: Kasāle plants had grown along the edge of the field.

definition: the egret Egretta garzetta of Ciconliformes of Ardeidae family, with long, black bill and legs, and white or dull-white plumes, that lives by rivers, ponds, and in marshy areas.
example_en: The egret was walking about in the river water.

definition: the prepared fiber of the husks of coconuts, used to make matting and rope; coir.
example: ಹಗ್ಗ ಮತ್ತು ಚಾಪೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಕಾತಿ ಬೇಕು.
example_en: Coir is needed to make rope and matting.

definition: the pain caused by contraction of a muscle or muscles from chill.
example: ತಣ್ಣೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಈಜಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನ ಕಾಲಿಗೆ ಕೊಡೆತ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: After swimming in the cold water, cramping pain came to his leg.

definition: a man who buys and sells commodities for profit; a dealer; a trader; a merchant.
example: ಬ್ಯಾರಿ ದಿನವೂ ಪೇಟೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಸರಕು ಮಾರುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The trader went to the market every day and sold goods.

definition: an amount deducted by the purchaser from the value while paying cash against a bill of exchange, promissory note, etc. to cover his interest cost for the unexpired period; a discount.
example: ಹುಂಡಿಯ ಹಣ ಕೊಡುವಾಗ ಸಾಹುಕಾರನು ವಡ್ಡ ಕಡಿತಗೊಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: While paying the bill amount, the merchant deducted a discount.

definition: to analyse and find out the cause of a disease.
example_en: The doctor diagnosed the cause of the disease.

definition: to speak or say with involuntary pauses or blocks, often with rapid repetitions of syllables or initial sounds, as temporarily from excitement, embarrassment, etc. or chronically as a result of muscle spasms believed to result from mental conflicts; to stutter; to stammer.
example_en: That boy spoke stammering out of nervousness.

definition: to know by practice or experience.
example_en: He learned the tricks of business by knowing it through practice.

definition: a small chest or box, as for jewels; a casket.
example_en: She arranged the child's toys in the small box.

definition: the quality or condition of being impure within.
example_en: His mind was filled with inner impurity.

definition: a man who supervises; superintendent; manager; director.
example_en: His application received acceptance from the committee.

definition: that has come or gone near.
example_en: This is a place that was visited (come near to) in the past.

definition: a pipe - a) a long tube of clay, concrete, metal, plastic, etc. for conveying water, gas, oil etc.; b) a tubular organ of the body.
example_en: They fitted a pipe to bring water to the house.

definition: a large number of persons or things, when gathered together or considered as a unit; a multitude; an assemblage.
example_en: The multitude of people at the fair was very large.

definition: afterwards; subsequently.
example_en: They distributed the offering subsequently after the worship.

definition: the quality or condition of being new; newness; freshness.
example_en: Everyone liked the newness of the new clothes.

definition: to be removed; to be warded off; to be turned aside.
example_en: That danger will not be warded off.

definition: to rub - a) to move one's hand, a cloth, etc. over (a surface or object) with pressure and friction, in a circular or back-and-forth motion; b) to move (one's hand, a cloth, etc.) over or spread or apply (polish, etc.) on or over, a surface or object in this way; c) to move (a thing) against something else or move (things) over each other with pressure and friction; d) to apply pressure and friction to, for cleaning, polishing, smoothing, etc.
example_en: She was rubbing the table with a cloth.

definition: a man, who leads an unrestrained, sexually immoral life; a rake; a libertine.
example_en: People scorned him as a debauched libertine.

definition: the tree Guazuma tomentosa ( = Buboma tomentosa) of Sterculaceae family; bastard cedar.
example: ಅಡವಿರುದ್ರಾಕ್ಷಿ ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ನಿಂತು ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದರು.
example_en: They stood under the bastard cedar tree and rested.

definition: the act of tending, feeding, keeping tidy, etc.; a grooming.
example_en: He lovingly tended and groomed the cattle.

definition: one who steers a ship or boat; a helmsman.
example_en: The helmsman steered the boat carefully through the storm.

definition: the quality, state or fact of being wrinkled, contracted.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಚರ್ಮದ ಸುರುಂಟು ಅವನ ವಯಸ್ಸನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The wrinkled state of the old skin showed his age.

definition: a shaking vehemently.
example_en: The walls cracked from the earthquake's violent shaking.

definition: a cursory look or glance.
example_en: He cast a cursory glance over the book.

definition: to bind, fasten or attach with a cord, string, rope or the like, drawn together and knotted; to tie.
example_en: He tied the sack tightly with a rope.

definition: a fight between two armed forces; a war.
example: ಎರಡು ದೇಶಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಘೋರ ಕಾದು ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A fierce war took place between the two countries.

definition: an undertaking; a venture; an enterprise.
example: ಅವನ ಉದ್ಯುಕ್ತನ ಹೊಸ ಉದ್ಯಮಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಬೇಕಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His venture needed capital for the new business.

definition: the quality, state or condition of being useless; uselessness.
example: ಈ ಹಳೆಯ ಯಂತ್ರದ ಅನುಪಯೋಗ ನಮಗೆ ಈಗ ಗೊತ್ತಾಯಿತು.
example_en: We now realise the uselessness of this old machine.

definition: the tendency of a person who is maliciously annoying.
example_en: All the villagers are fed up with her maliciously annoying ways.

definition: the large intestine.
example_en: The last part of digestion happens in the large intestine.

definition: the climber Luffa acutangula (= Cucumis acutangula) of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The ridged gourd creeper had spread over the fence.

definition: a variety in mushrooms, that grows in rocky region.
example_en: The rock mushroom was found among the boulders of the hill.

definition: a devotional song.
example_en: In the evening they sang a devotional song in the temple.

definition: the left-over in a dining plate; anything that has come into contact with the mouth, tongue or teeth or the hands of the person while taking food (considered defiled).
example_en: The children threw away the leftover food.

definition: the movement of an orbiting celestial object, as a star or planet, completely around another object; a revolving or a rovolution.
example: ಭೂಮಿಯ ಪೇರಿ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಸುತ್ತ ಒಂದು ವರ್ಷ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The earth's revolution around the sun takes one year.

definition: a round-about way; a way that is not direct.
example_en: Since the direct road was closed, we went by a roundabout way.

definition: a man who is suffering for want of water.
example: ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರುಗೇಡಿಯು ಬಾವಿಯ ಬಳಿ ನಿಂತು ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: In the summer, the man suffering for want of water stood waiting near the well.

definition: a knob - a) a rounded lump or protuberance; b) a ball-like handle of a door, drawer, etc.; c) a similar device used in controlling the operation of equipments as a radio, TV receiver, etc.
example_en: They fitted a new knob to the door.

definition: the quality of being natural; naturalness.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುವ ಸಹಜತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಇಷ್ಟವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Everyone liked the naturalness in his speech.

definition: a military projectile used in ancient warfare to hurl heavy objects against the defensive wall of the fortified place of one's enemy.
example_en: In olden days they used the projectile in warfare.

definition: totally violent, turbulent and unsophisticated behaviour.
example_en: Seeing his violent and unruly behaviour, everyone was frightened.

definition: the quality of being natural; naturalness.
example: ಆ ಚಿತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಣ್ಣಗಳ ಸಾಜತೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮೂಡಿಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: The naturalness of colors has come out well in that painting.

definition: a fraction of a second; a very short duration.
example_en: The accident happened in a fraction of a second.

definition: a sort of deadly poison.
example_en: The story of the deadly poison halahala is famous in the puranas.

definition: a thin chip chiselled out of a stone.
example: ಕಲ್ಲುಕುಟಿಗ ಗೋಡೆಗೆ ಒಂದು ಚಕ್ಕೆಗಲ್ಲು ಕೆತ್ತಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The stonemason chiselled a thin stone chip and fitted it to the wall.

definition: any elongated usu. wingless insect of the family Phasmidae with a twiglike body; a stick-insect.
example: ಎಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತ ಕಡ್ಡಿಕೀಟ ಕೊಂಬೆಯಂತೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The stick-insect sitting on the leaf looked just like a twig.

definition: any game of chance played with stake or stakes.
example: ಅವನು ಕುದುರೆ ಓಟದಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬಾಜಿ ಆಡಿದನು.
example_en: He played a big game of chance in the horse race.

definition: an instrument to let down or raise the inner latch of a door from outside.
example_en: He pulled the door latch-lifter and came inside.

definition: that which is sharp, keen.
example_en: That knife's sharpness was very keen.

definition: (mus.) a musical mode derived from the main mode Dhīra Śankarābharaṇa, in Ka rnāṭak a system.
example_en: The singer sang a devotional song in the Begade raga.

definition: a particular lock or hold in wrestling.
example: ಗುರು ಶಿಷ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಸಿರಣವಟ್ಟಿ ಎಂಬ ಹಿಡಿತವನ್ನು ಕಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The teacher taught the disciple the hold called siranavatti.

definition: covered, daubed, smeared with (something oily, sticky, greasy, etc.).
example_en: She washed the cloth that was smeared with oil.

definition: iron, the widely used metal having atomic number 26.
example_en: They built that bridge using iron.

definition: to move as from mental or internal agitation; to be mentally perturbed.
example_en: On hearing the news, his mind became mentally perturbed.

definition: a mixture of more than two colours.
example_en: The cloth's mixture of many colours attracted everyone's attention.

definition: the sensation of itching.
example_en: One should not scratch when there is itching on the skin.

definition: the theory that considers the universe as issuing from the essence of god; the theory of emanation.
example_en: That philosopher propounded the theory of emanation.

definition: to try to prove by giving reasons; to contend; to argue.
example_en: In the meeting, they argued to prove their point.

definition: a malleable, magnetic, readily oxidizable metal which is a chemical element of the transition series (atomic no. 26), occurs abundantly in certain ores and in meteorites, and is widely used, chiefly in alloys such as steel, for tools, implements, structures, machinery, etc.; iron.
example_en: The blacksmith heated the iron and made a sword.

definition: the inner portion, region of anything.
example_en: The friends shared their innermost feelings with each other.

definition: the earth.
example_en: The earth turned green and shone due to the rain.

definition: to be very eager to; to have an irrepressible desire to do or get.
example_en: That boy was irrepressibly eager to eat sweets.

definition: a sour sauce or relish made chiefly of tamarind fruits and seasoned with spices.
example_en: Mother made tamarind pickle relish.

definition: a strong carving; a desire.
example_en: The desire for wealth blinded him.

definition: a torn or worn piece or pieces of cloth.
example_en: The poor old woman lay down wrapped in a torn piece of cloth.

definition: thence - a) from that place; therefrom; b) from that point of time; thenceforth.
example: ಅವನು ಊರು ಬಿಟ್ಟನು, ಐಂದ ಮತ್ತೆ ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He left the town, and thenceforth never returned.

definition: the sharp, short sound made by snapping a finger with the thumb.
example_en: He snapped his fingers with a chutaku sound and showed the rhythm.

definition: watery mud; slush; mire.
example_en: After the rain, the path was full of watery mud.

definition: a soft lump of earth, clay, etc.; clot.
example_en: The potter made a pot from a lump of clay.

definition: to extend oneself; to be extended or expanded; to sprad.
example_en: The flames of fire spread over the entire forest.

definition: to press or push (a sharp object) into or through; to pierce.
example_en: The blacksmith pierced a hole into the iron.

definition: the act of seeing with the eye; vision.
example_en: The sight of that scene astonished everyone.

definition: (underground water) to come forth; to ooze.
example_en: After the rain, water oozed forth from the ground.

definition: final, ending; last.
example_en: This is the final chapter of this book.

definition: elegance, refinement, cultivation, finish or the like got by polishing; polish.
example_en: He got new polish applied to the vehicle.

definition: the chief of a region or district.
example_en: The chief of the region was looking after all the affairs of the town.

definition: the realisation of the fact or state of oneness or unity.
example_en: Through meditation he attained the realisation of oneness.

definition: a nomadic Romany caste.
example_en: People of the Lambani community speak their own language.

definition: the life lasting only one day (that is, very short-lived); ephemeral life.
example_en: The poor man's ephemeral, day-to-day life was very hard.

definition: a head having thinly and unevenly grown hair.
example_en: The comb would not catch in the grandmother's head of thin uneven hair.

definition: (myth.) the serpent-demon who is supposed to eclipse the sun and moon; Rāhu.
example: ಪುರಾಣದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ರಾವು ಸೂರ್ಯನನ್ನು ಗ್ರಹಣ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: According to mythology, Rahu eclipses the sun.

definition: to criticise or reproach severely; to speak assaultingly; to abuse, upbraid.
example_en: The father severely reproached the son who had erred.

definition: that which is fit to be eaten; edible; food; an eatable.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಗೆಬಗೆಯ ಭೋಜ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: On the festival day, they prepared various kinds of food at home.

definition: to make a hoarse, indistinct sound in the uncleared throat (as from cold etc.).
example_en: Because of his cold, he made a hoarse sound in the middle of the meeting.

definition: any of several families of primates usu. Having a flat, hairless face and a long tail a monkey.
example_en: The monkey snatched the fruits from the tree.

definition: to be afraid of.
example_en: She was afraid to walk alone in the dark.

definition: any of the soft, boneless area in the skull of a baby, which is later closed up by the formation of bone; fontanelle.
example: ಶಿಶುವಿನ ಅಳಿನೆತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ತಾಯಿ ಬಹಳ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಮುಟ್ಟಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother touched the baby's fontanelle very carefully.

definition: (pl.) a dwelling house and a religious monastery.
example_en: In that settlement there were dwelling houses and monasteries.

definition: remove or separate by or as by passing through a sieve; to sieve.
example_en: The farmer sieved the paddy and separated the chaff.

definition: a head having no hair; a completely bald head.
example_en: The old man had a completely bald head.

definition: any of the sons of a king, monarch.
example_en: That prince ascended the throne at a young age.

definition: to question; to inquire about.
example_en: The teacher questioned the disciple.

definition: the condition of being inclined or deviated from the regular course.
example_en: Because of the arrow's deviation, it missed the target.

definition: a person, thing or event that causes astonishment and admiration; marvel; wonder.
example_en: His achievement is truly a marvel.

definition: a network of rope that can be suspended from the roof-beam of a house, used to keep vessels from the easy reach of children or cats, rats, etc.
example: ಅಡುಗೆ ಮನೆಯ ಚಿಕ್ಕುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಲಿನ ಪಾತ್ರೆ ಇಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: They kept the milk vessel in the hanging net of the kitchen.

definition: matters of business or concern; affairs.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಊರಿನ ಆಗುಂಚೇಗಿಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಚಿಂತೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He was worried about the town's affairs.

definition: pure water.
example: ಆ ಬುಗ್ಗೆಯ ಸುವಾರಿ ಕುಡಿಯಲು ತುಂಬಾ ರುಚಿಯಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The pure water of that spring was very tasty to drink.

definition: absolute darkness; lack of light.
example_en: On that rainy night absolute darkness had enveloped the forest.

definition: a bone disease characterised by a softening of the bones, resulting from deficient bone calcification; osteomalacia.
example_en: His bones had become soft due to the disease of osteomalacia.

definition: a room for confinement in childbirth; a lying-in-chamber.
example_en: The new mother was kept in the lying-in-chamber.

definition: a small chest or box, as for jewels; a casket.
example_en: She kept the valuable items in the small casket.

definition: he who is completely surrendered to his desire.
example: ಆ ಕಡುಮೋಹಿತ ಹಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಮಾಡಲು ಸಿದ್ಧ.
example_en: That person, fully surrendered to his desire for money, is ready to do anything.

definition: a name; an appellation.
example_en: The name of that mountain appears in the mythology.

definition: one who betrays his lover.
example_en: It became known that he was a betrayer of his lover.

definition: a part or portion that is allotted to a person; such a portion that a person gets or is entitled to.
example: ಆಸ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಹಚ್ಚೆಲ ಎಷ್ಟು ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: They asked what his allotted share in the property was.

definition: (adj.) repeatedly but not at regular intervals.
example_en: He kept coming and going repeatedly at irregular intervals.

definition: the early stage of one's life; childhood or boyhood.
example_en: In his childhood he was very mischievous.

definition: to cause to jump or hop.
example_en: Seeing the baby, she made it jump.

definition: that much quantity which is more than required.
example_en: There was surplus stock, more than required, in the warehouse.

definition: the result of illusion or error or infatuation.
example_en: The result of his infatuation led him astray.

definition: a period of considerably long time.
example_en: They were on a journey for a considerably long time.

definition: inclined or ready to quarrel, fight, make arguments; contentious; quarrelsome.
example: ಅವನು ಸಣ್ಣ ಮಾತಿಗೂ ಹೊರ್ಕುಳಿಯಾಗಿ ಜಗಳ ಆಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He is so quarrelsome that he fights even over small talk.

definition: observing the appointed time; on time; punctually.
example_en: He came to the meeting exactly on time.

definition: an artificial source of light; a lamp.
example_en: As soon as it turned dark, they lit the lamp in the house.

definition: a man who jests with a silly role in a drama, cinema, etc. a jester; a joker.
example_en: The joker made everyone laugh with his words.

definition: a Śaiva devotee.
example: ಆ ಶಾಂಭವ ಪ್ರತಿನಿತ್ಯ ಶಿವನ ಪೂಜೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That Śaiva devotee worships Shiva every day.

definition: a disorganised collection of persons; a crowd.
example_en: The disorganised crowd gathered at the fair and caused a commotion.

definition: (the female reproductive cell) to be impregnated successfully.
example_en: That year the cow did not conceive.

definition: to send, submit (an application, petition, etc.).
example_en: He submitted the application to the government.

definition: to make, prepare a sacrificial altar.
example_en: The priests prepared the sacrificial altar for the yajna.

definition: the tree Boswellia serrata of Burseraceae family.
example_en: The anebela tree had grown in the forest.

definition: an act of withholding from being manifested; an abstaining from being seen.
example: ಆ ರಹಸ್ಯ ಸತ್ಯ ಇಂದಿಗೂ ಅನಾವಿರ್ಭಾವವಾಗಿಯೇ ಉಳಿದಿದೆ.
example_en: That secret truth still remains unmanifested to this day.

definition: the sound made by water while boiling.
example_en: The water in the vessel boiled making a churu-churu sound.

definition: a huge drum, percussion instrument.
example_en: They beat the huge drum loudly at the festival.

definition: a bad conduct; improper behaviour.
example_en: His improper conduct became known to the whole town.

definition: to go under the surface of water; to plunge; to immerse oneself.
example: ಮಗು ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಡುಬಾಯಿಸಿ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೊತ್ತು ಮೇಲೆ ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The child plunged into the water and did not come up for a while.

definition: that which is not an acid.
example_en: This solution is completely free of acid.

definition: to take air into the lungs and let out again; to inhale and exhale; to breathe.
example_en: Breathing deeply, he became calm.

definition: to desire vehemently; to covet.
example_en: He coveted the neighbor's land.

definition: a man belonging to Negro people.
example_en: He is a Negro, originally from Africa.

definition: absence or want of facility or comfort; inconvenience; discomfort.
example: ಈ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರಿನ ಅಸೌಕರ್ಯ ಬಹಳ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is great inconvenience of water in this house.

definition: the rear portion of anything.
example_en: They kept the luggage in the rear portion of the vehicle.

definition: a cot made of ropes or cords.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಹೊರಸಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಲಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The village people used to sleep on the rope cot at night.

definition: a man whose actions belie stated beliefs; he who pretends to have virtues, moral or religious beliefs, principles, etc., which he does not actually possess; a hypocrite.
example: ಆ ಢಾಳಕ ಬಾಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು, ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That hypocrite says one thing and does another.

definition: pleasing to hear; sounding sweet; melodious.
example_en: Her melodious voice captivated everyone.

definition: to bear pain, inconvenience etc. without flinching; to hold out; to endure.
example: ಅವನು ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಕಷ್ಟ ಬಂದರೂ ಉಱಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಮುಂದೆ ಸಾಗಿದನು.
example_en: However much hardship came, he endured it and moved forward.

definition: a brave fighter, soldier.
example_en: That brave soldier joined the king's army.

definition: the rent paid for the usage of vacant site.
example: ಅವನು ಅಡಿಸ್ಥಳದ ಬಾಡಿಗೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He pays the rent for the vacant site every month.

definition: a flat, coarse fabric made of woven or plaited hemp, straw etc., used to sit on; a mat.
example_en: The grandmother spread the mat and sat down.

definition: a single tooth.
example_en: Only a single tooth was left in the boy's mouth.

definition: a gift or present made.
example_en: The students gave a gift to the teacher.

definition: the outermost entrance; the main entrance.
example_en: The guards were standing at the main entrance of the palace.

definition: (a plant) to put forth a new branch or branches.
example: ಗಿಡ ಮಳೆ ಬಿದ್ದ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊಸ ಕವಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಮೆಯ್ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The plant puts forth new branches after the rain falls.

definition: a man who leads by directing, comanding or guiding others; a leader.
example: ಆ ಪಡೆಯ ಮುಂಚ ಸೈನಿಕರನ್ನು ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: That leader of the troop led the soldiers into battle.

definition: the vocative of a noun.
example_en: The vocative is a separate case in grammar.

definition: acquaintance that has not grown intimate; casual acquaintance.
example_en: Those two have only a casual acquaintance, not a close friendship.

definition: never existing before; appearing, thought of, developed, made, produced, etc. for the first time; new.
example_en: He had a new house built.

definition: illness; disease.
example_en: Her illness worsened during the rainy season.

definition: a wooden, hollow mould used in casting.
example: ಕುಂಬಾರ ಅಚ್ಚುಮರದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಬೊಂಬೆಗಳನ್ನು ಎರಕ ಹೊಯ್ದನು.
example_en: The potter cast clay dolls in the wooden mould.

definition: a severe pain.
example_en: He experienced a severe pain in his stomach.

definition: to come and go in between; to interfere.
example_en: He interfered in between our conversation.

definition: a non-rigid container made of fabric, paper, leather, etc., with an opening at the top that can be closed; a sack or pouch; a bag.
example_en: She filled the rice into a sack.

definition: a suspending or being suspended; suspension.
example_en: The suspension of the bridge was at a great height.

definition: (pl.) four (or many) roads.
example_en: People were crowded at those many roads.

definition: the plant Dolichandrone arcuata of Bignoniaceae family.
example_en: The udure tree was full of white flowers.

definition: to come in to physical contact with; to touch.
example_en: The hand touched the wall.

definition: disorder caused in the production and function of bile in the body.
example_en: Eating too much spicy food causes bile disorder.

definition: paddy that is pounded but not fully.
example_en: They pounded the dried paddy to make partly husked paddy.

definition: a device for pulling corks out of bottles, usu. a spiral-shaped piece of steel with a point at one end and a handle at the other; a cork-screw.
example_en: A corkscrew was needed to open the wine bottle.

definition: fierce; savage; violently cruel.
example: ಆ ವಿಗಡ ಹುಲಿ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಭಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That fierce tiger struck fear in everyone in the forest.

definition: the act of joining two or more things together.
example: ಎರಡು ಪದಗಳ ಸಮಾಸ ಹೊಸ ಅರ್ಥ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The joining of two words gave a new meaning.

definition: a devoted, loyal wife.
example_en: She, being a devoted wife, was engaged in serving her husband.

definition: to move one's brow or brows to expresss one's feelings or to convey something.
example_en: He moved his brow to express his surprise.

definition: a sharp circular missile weapon; a discuss.
example_en: The warrior hurled the discus at the enemy.

definition: the act of rising; a getting up; a rise.
example_en: The sun's rise appeared in the eastern direction.

definition: the state or feeling of being excited by joy; ecstatic delight.
example_en: On hearing the result, she felt an ecstatic delight.

definition: the broken outer coat or husk, of grains of rice, wheat, etc. separated from the flour after grinding, as by sifting; bran.
example_en: They fed the rice bran to the animals.

definition: a man who cleans; a cleaner.
example: ಆ ಸಾಪುಗಾರ ಮನೆಯನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಫಳಫಳ ಹೊಳೆಯುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That cleaner made the whole house shine spotlessly.

definition: that what happens later or as a result of something; consequence.
example_en: The consequence of that decision was not good for everyone.

definition: a man who is morally base or evil; a wicked man.
example_en: That wicked man used to cheat everyone.

definition: a payment, not wages, made regularly to a person (or to his family) who has fulfilled certain conditions of service, reached a certain age, etc.; pension.
example: ಅವನ ಪಿಂಚನ್ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳೂ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: His pension comes to the bank every month.

definition: a mighty king.
example_en: The mighty king defeated the enemies and protected the kingdom.

definition: a killing of a woman or women.
example: ಆ ಕ್ರೂರ ಪೆಂಗೊಲೆಯ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಊರಿಡೀ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: The news of that cruel killing of a woman spread throughout the town.

definition: an unrestrained and grossly lecherous man; a libertine; a lecher.
example: ಎೞ್ತುವೊಜಂಗನಾದ ಅವನು ಹೆಂಗಸರನ್ನು ಕಂಡರೆ ಕಣ್ಣು ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: Being a lecher, he turns his eyes toward every woman he sees.

definition: the superintendent of a kitchen (in a palace).
example_en: Under the kitchen superintendent's supervision, the kitchen was kept clean.

definition: (dial.) a kind of social wasp of Vespidae family; a hornet.
example_en: The hornet chases after children as soon as it sees them.

definition: the amount paid or to be paid, to use a house, other property of another, at fixed intervals (as a month, year, etc.) rent.
example_en: One has to pay the house rent every month.

definition: to wish or long for; to desire.
example_en: She longed for her mother's blessing.

definition: a man who has the tendency to talk lightly on any or various subjects.
example_en: That chatterbox man was chatting idly with everyone.

definition: a kind of deadly poison.
example_en: There was a deadly poison in that snake's bite.

definition: any of the veins on the right side of the body.
example_en: The doctor examined his vein on the right side of the body.

definition: communication by exchange of letters; correspondence.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರು ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ನಡುವೆ ಪತ್ರವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಇನ್ನೂ ಮುಂದುವರಿದಿದೆ.
example_en: The correspondence between the two friends is still continuing.

definition: a making of harsh sounds in breathing, while asleep as caused by vibration of the soft palate usu. with the mouth open; the act or sound of snoring.
example_en: His snoring kept me from falling asleep.

definition: the fact or condition of being pervaded through out; diffusion; pervasion.
example: ಆ ಸುವಾಸನೆಯ ಅಳುರ್ಕೆ ಇಡೀ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: The pervasion of that fragrance spread throughout the house.

definition: a band tied by a girl to his brother, on the full moon-day of Śrāvaṇa (the fifth month in Hindu calendar) to protect from evil spirits, mishaps, etc.
example_en: The sister tied a raakhi on her brother's wrist.

definition: a water-passage; a channel.
example_en: The channel was full of rubbish.

definition: the act of raising aloft; a lifting or pulling up.
example_en: The lifting up of the boulder was very strenuous.

definition: a fighting with finger nails or claws.
example_en: A fight with nails and claws took place between the two boys.

definition: (pl.) two folds (of a cloth, paper, etc.).
example_en: She adjusted the two folds of the sari.

definition: a person who weaves; esp. one whose work is weaving; a weaver.
example_en: The weaver wove the saree beautifully.

definition: the act of restraining or the fact of having restrained, the mind; control of passions.
example_en: The sage had achieved control over the senses.

definition: (deog.) the face of a person.
example_en: Seeing his face, laughter came.

definition: shower of meteors by intersection of meteor streams by the earth; meteoric shower.
example_en: People looked up to watch the meteoric shower.

definition: a bird (esp. the one of good or bad omen).
example: ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಆ ಶಕುನ ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿತು.
example_en: In the morning, that omen-bird appeared before the house.

definition: to answer; to reply; to respond.
example_en: That boy did not respond to the shout.

definition: a giving of a promise.
example_en: He gave a promise of help.

definition: a brave, courageous man.
example_en: The brave, courageous soldier faced the enemies alone.

definition: to wear (flowers) on one's head; to set (flowers) in one's tress.
example_en: She set flowers in her hair.

definition: a white, ductile metallic element, used for making mirrors, coins ornaments, table utensils, photographic chemicals, conductors, etc. silver (Symbol: Ag).
example_en: The grandmother was wearing silver bangles.

definition: an account of daily income and expenditure.
example_en: The clerk used to record the daily account of income and expenditure every day.

definition: the black bumble-bee.
example_en: A bumble-bee had built a nest in the tree's hollow.

definition: a jumping or leaping forward.
example: ಹುಲಿ ಮರದ ಕೆಳಗಿನಿಂದ ಧೀಂಕು ಹಾಕಿ ಬೇಟೆಯ ಮೇಲೆರಗಿತು.
example_en: The tiger leapt forward from under the tree onto its prey.

definition: the chief of an army; a military commander.
example_en: The army commander led the troops to the battlefield.

definition: a woman who loves and loyally or zealously supports one's own country; a patriot.
example_en: That patriot woman took part in the freedom struggle.

definition: mutual conversation.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಮಿತ್ರರು ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಕೂಡುಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಡಗಿದರು.
example_en: Both the friends engaged in mutual conversation in front of the house.

definition: a kind of banyan tree.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕಿನ್ನಿಗೋಳಿ ಮರ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A large banyan tree of the kinnigoli kind had grown in the middle of the village.

definition: the act of sprinkling; a pouring in small drops or particles.
example_en: They did a sprinkling of water on the flowers.

definition: a long, round cushion or pillow to lean on, while sitting; a bolster.
example_en: Grandmother sat leaning against the bolster.

definition: relating to or made of bamboo.
example_en: He played a bamboo flute.

definition: to cause to jump up or over.
example_en: The trainer made the horse jump over the obstacle.

definition: a sticking (to other person) as a leech.
example_en: He stuck to his friend like a clinging leech.

definition: to cut into two slices; to split.
example_en: She split the vegetable into two and cooked it.

definition: a family; a lineage; a race.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ವಂಶದ ಇತಿಹಾಸದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯಿಂದ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He spoke proudly about the history of his lineage.

definition: to get or perceive the right meaning of; to know or grasp what is actually meant by.
example_en: Do not decide without grasping the right meaning of people's words.

definition: a melodious tune; an agreeable sound.
example_en: A melodious tune came out of the flute.

definition: a kind of folk song.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರು ದಿಮ್ಮಿ ಎಂಬ ಜಾನಪದ ಹಾಡನ್ನು ಹಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The village people sang the folk song called dimmi.

definition: a giving or taking of one thing for another; an exchange.
example_en: The exchange of the two items happened easily.

definition: a man who operates a machine.
example_en: That machine operator was running the machine in the factory.

definition: the quality of being bright; brightness; lustre.
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಪೊಗರು ಕೆರೆಯ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The brightness of the morning sun shone in the water of the lake.

definition: the boundary or border of a country.
example_en: The enemies came crossing that country's border.

definition: softness; tenderness.
example: ಆ ರೇಷ್ಮೆ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಮೆಲುವು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಇಷ್ಟವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Everyone liked the softness of that silk cloth.

definition: hereditary - a) of or passed down by, heredity; designating or of a characteristic transmitted genetically from generation to generation; b) of or passed down by, inheritance from an ancestor to a legal heir; ancestral; or having title, right, etc. by inheritance.
example_en: This disease comes from hereditary causes.

definition: a place abounding with flowers; nosegay.
example_en: That garden is truly a place abounding with flowers.

definition: the rear portion.
example: ಗುಂಪಿನ ಪಿಂಬಕ್ಕ ನಿಂತ ಜನ ಮುಂದೆ ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The people standing at the rear of the group did not come forward.

definition: (a term used with reference to animals) the condition of having an offspring developing in the uterus; pregnancy.
example_en: That cow's pregnancy was of six months.

definition: a violent storm with high winds; tornado; hurricane.
example_en: The hurricane that came at night destroyed the whole town.

definition: the edible seeds of certain leguminous plants, as peas or beans.
example_en: They cook pulses and use them for the meal.

definition: braided hair.
example_en: She had gotten her hair braided.

definition: downward inclination; a descending slope; declivity.
example_en: One must be careful while descending the slope of the hill.

definition: the act or an instance of traveling from one place to another; journey.
example_en: Our journey begins tomorrow morning.

definition: he who stabs others; a stabber.
example_en: That stabber had instilled fear in the village.

definition: a financial institution which lends money on the security of a deposit or on the mortgage of a property.
example_en: He pledged his jewellery in the mortgage bank and took a loan.

definition: the hollowed palm (as to hold something).
example_en: The old woman held water in her hollowed palm and drank it.

definition: the state or quality of being the Supreme Being.
example_en: The devotees praised the state of being the Supreme Being and sang hymns.

definition: a high-ranking member of the Christian clergy having authority, variously, over other clergy and usu. supervising a diocese or church district; a bishop.
example_en: The bishop conducted the prayer in the church.

definition: (dial.) that which does not have a definite shape.
example: ಆ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಅಂಡಕ ಯಾವ ಆಕಾರವೂ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That lump of clay lay without any definite shape.

definition: a bad, dreadful, evil-foreboding dream.
example_en: The child who woke up in the morning had had a bad dream.

definition: a place where supplies are kept; a storehouse; a warehouse.
example_en: They had stacked sacks of rice in the storehouse.

definition: a drain, usu. underground, used to carry off water and waste matter; a sewer.
example_en: There was an underground sewer beneath the street.

definition: one of the several portions of a whole.
example_en: One portion of the property came to him.

definition: a written acknowledgment that something, as goods, money, etc., has been received; a receipt.
example_en: After paying the money, I received a receipt.

definition: the act of dying; the end of life; the total and permanent cessation of all the vital functions of an organism; death.
example: ಸಾವು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಒಂದು ದಿನ ಬರುವ ಸತ್ಯ.
example_en: Death is a truth that comes to everyone one day.

definition: a plant that lives on or in another plant and obtains nutriment from the later.
example_en: A parasitic plant grew on that tree.

definition: great sorrow; violent grief.
example_en: Her son's death brought her violent grief.

definition: the solstice (the day on which the sun is farthest north of celestial equator) at midsummer, at the time of the longest day, about 21 June in the northern hemisphere; the summer solstice.
example: ಕಟಕಾಯನದ ದಿನ ಸೂರ್ಯ ಉತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ ಬಹಳ ದೂರ ಸಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: On the day of the summer solstice, the sun travels far to the north.

definition: a person from whom one is descended; an ancestor.
example_en: Our ancestor settled in this town.

definition: the crossbar of a balance.
example_en: The shopkeeper fixed the crossbar of the balance.

definition: a dividing or being divided; separation.
example_en: The separation of the field took place in the village council.

definition: afterwards; subsequently.
example: ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಬೞಿಕ್ಕಂ ಅವನು ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದನು.
example_en: He took rest afterwards after finishing the work.

definition: a black, porous, amorphous form of carbon produced by destructive distillation of wood or other organic matter; charcoal.
example_en: Grandmother used charcoal for cooking.

definition: a very hot sunlight.
example_en: The scorching sunlight in summer exhausted everyone.

definition: to miss one's path, course of action; to go astray.
example_en: In the middle of the forest, the hunter lost his way.

definition: an elephant driver.
example_en: The elephant driver led the elephant into the forest.

definition: a camp or a tent in the outskirts of a town.
example_en: The soldiers stayed in a camp on the outskirts of the town.

definition: a noisy or violent contention or dispute, an altercation, a brawl, a petty fight; a quarrel.
example_en: A brawl broke out in the market.

definition: (joy) to overwhelm; to become excessive.
example_en: His mind was overwhelmed with joy.

definition: a march of victory.
example_en: The king set out on a march of victory.

definition: a variety of barley.
example_en: This variety of barley is grown in this field.

definition: a sum of money or another reward offered in order to influence to do or demanded to do, an illegal or dishonest action or decision in favour of the giver; bribe.
example_en: The policeman was caught taking a bribe.

definition: a flavoured solution of sugar and water boiled togther; a kind of syrup.
example_en: In summer, she prepared a cool sugar syrup.

definition: anything wound or gathered into a series of rings or a spiral; a coil.
example_en: The coil of the rope had wound around the pillar.

definition: a man who guides, directs or advises.
example_en: The teacher who guides showed us the path.

definition: to give room, interval or space (in between).
example_en: Leave a little space between the two houses.

definition: love; affection; tender feeling.
example: ತಾಯಿಗೆ ಮಗುವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಅಪಾರ ಅಲಪು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The mother had immense affection for the child.

definition: the state or fact of being a bridegroom or bride.
example: ಮದವಣಿಗತನವು ಅವನ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹೊಸ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯವನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The state of being a bridegroom opened a new chapter in his life.

definition: an ignorant, uneducated or stupid man.
example: ಆ ಶುದ್ಧಪಿಟಿಪಿಟಿರಾಯ ಯಾವ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನೂ ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That ignorant fool did not understand anything at all.

definition: stinking ghee.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಮಡಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊೞೆದುಪ್ಪ ಕೆಟ್ಟ ವಾಸನೆ ಬೀರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The stinking ghee in the old pot was giving off a bad smell.

definition: the climber vine Piper betle of Piperaceae family.
example_en: They brought and kept betel leaves for the worship.

definition: to decorate; to adorn; to ornament.
example_en: She adorned her hair with flowers.
